_comment: Your affiliate / gear list. Edit freely — this file is the single source for the /gear/ page and for `gear:` references in post front matter. If AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG is set, bare amazon.* URLs below get the tag appended automatically at build time, so you never have to paste tagged links by hand.

items.name: 75% Hot-swap Mechanical Keyboard
items.blurb: Gasket mount, hot-swap sockets, and a knob I use far more than I expected. The board I type every post on.
items.why: Hot-swap means I can change switches without a soldering iron, which matters a lot when you review keyboards for a living.

items.name: Lightweight Wireless Gaming Mouse
items.blurb: Sub-60g, no perceptible latency over its own dongle, and the battery genuinely lasts a working week.
items.why: The weight is the whole point. Going back to a 100g mouse now feels like dragging a brick.

items.name: USB Condenser Microphone
items.blurb: What every voiceover on the channel is recorded through. Cardioid, onboard monitoring, no interface needed.
items.why: It is the cheapest single upgrade that makes a video sound less amateur. Audio matters more than resolution.

items.name: 27" 1440p 165Hz IPS Monitor
items.blurb: The resolution and refresh sweet spot. High enough DPI to read code all day, fast enough that games feel right.
items.why: 1440p at 27" is the size where you stop noticing pixels without needing to scale the UI.

items.name: Open-back Studio Headphones
items.blurb: Open-back, flat response, and comfortable enough for a six-hour editing session.
items.why: Flat response means what I mix sounds the same on other people's speakers. Open-back means my ears survive.

items.name: 1TB Portable NVMe SSD
items.blurb: Where raw footage lives before it gets edited. Fast enough to cut 4K directly off the drive.
items.why: Editing straight from the external drive removes an entire copy step from my workflow.
